moduleRecord.stated: not warranted on this verdict; the title, terms and e >= 0.05 questions are listed for the coordinator in case the finding is reconsidered
moduleRecord.title: propagator/sdn-ap: first-order zonal short-period terms J6 to J_MAXIMUM_DEGREE (m = 0, j >= 2) at the output step, small-e form in the argument of latitude
moduleRecord.terms: ZONAL-SHORT-PERIOD.md items 1 and 2: per object one table of 3 (L - 1) floats (the forced Hill response per harmonic j = 2..L of the summed J6..J_L force harmonics at the mean a, i, n), rebuilt when the mean i or a moves; applied to the osculating output position in RTN; the j = 0 and j = 1 members stay in the rates as today
eGte005Questions: the q = +-1 and +-2 sidebands (Kaula G_lpq, |q| <= 2) at e >= 0.05: the (0, j) members at j n +- q n and their identity with the narrow set's q in {-1, 0, 1} selection of the tesseral table (double counting at m = 0 must be excluded by construction)
the e-linearization of G about the epoch e (as the module's sp_g does for the tesseral table) against the exact Hansen coefficient for the zonal members at e 0.05 to 0.3

the j = 1 member at e >= 0.05: the once-per-revolution odd-l term is no longer the small-eccentricity-vector response; whether the odd-l long-period rates (w = +-1) still carry it or a short-period (l, 0, p, q = 0, j = 1) output term is needed
the wide-e class above kWideE 0.3: whether the zonal members enter the existing grid (every (l, 0, p, q) term) or stay in this table
the radial bias at fixed mean motion (item 3, R0_pred against the measured R0): whether the mean-to-osculating semi-major axis should carry the even-l constant term when the output table is added
